pages.text: Ars Nouveau lets you write your own spells from $(l)glyphs$(): a form, then effects, then augments.$(br2)$(li)The $(l:magic/ars#worn_notebook)Worn Notebook$(/l) is where it starts. You'll find its recipe at the end of this entry.

$(li)$(l)Source$() is its power. Sourcelinks gather it and a $(l:magic/ars#source_jar)Source Jar$(/l) holds it.$(li)An $(l:magic/ars#imbuement_chamber)Imbuement Chamber$(/l) steeps items in Source.$(li)Spells are written in a $(l:magic/ars#novice_spell_book)Novice Spell Book$(/l). New glyphs are crafted at a Scribe's Table.$(br2)Look for the bright archwood forests.
